query: 负责任营销政策 负责任营销政策 衡量企业营销活动在真实性、透明度、社会价值引导及弱势群体保护方面的规范程度。重点考察预防误导宣传、保护未成年人、广告审查流程及违规问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的负责任营销准则；包含明确的“禁误导/夸大”红线；针对未成年人或其他弱势群体有专项保护机制；设有独立的多级内容审查流程（如合规或法务会签）；具备明确的虚假宣传违规问责与纠偏机制。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的广告管理制度或包含在员工行为准则中，具备基础的真实性要求和法务审核环节，但缺乏针对未成年人等特定群体的保护细节或系统的问责逻辑。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“诚信经营”等口头表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：负责任营销政策覆盖 >80% 的产品线、业务单元、销售地区及所有营销渠道（含新媒体、直播、线下广告）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对大众传播而忽略了经销商、KOL 推广等私域场景，或未披露覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 负责任营销 广告规范 禁止误导宣传 未成年人保护 营销合规审查 广告审批 虚假宣传问责 responsible marketing advertising standards misleading claims protection of minors marketing compliance review advertising approval false advertising accountability 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '负责任营销政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有负责任营销或广告管理制度？ 是否明确禁止误导/夸大宣传？ 对未成年人或其他弱势群体有哪些专项保护？ 内容审查是否含合规/法务多级会签？ 虚假宣传的问责与纠偏机制是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“诚信经营”口号；仅有产品标签合规说明；仅有品牌传播案例；仅有客户隐私政策；区分：负责任营销规范宣传内容与受众保护；产品标签关注包装说明书信息披露；二者都涉及真实性，但场景与载体不同。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

The Group protects intellectual property rights of both itself and third parties. The Corporate Human Resources Department is responsible for providing guidelines on protecting intellectual property rights, and managing related assets such as logos, patents, trademarks and service marks, domain names, copyrights for both hardware and software etc. The use of all copyrighted materials of the Group should be authorised by the Corporate HR Department. results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Materiality Assessment

[Content]
A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.
